data.description: VANDENBERG AIR FORCE BASE, CALIF.  - One of four Solid Rocket Boosters for the CALIPSO_CloudSat launch is ready for lifting into the mobile service tower, or gantry, where it will be attached to the Boeing Delta II rocket.
